q-0308.answer:
Surah Aal-i-Imraan (3) — The Family of Imraan · 200 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Disbelief is far from touching you, since the Ayat of Allah are being sent down on His Messenger ﷺ day and night, and he recites and conveys them to you.
• Alif, Lam, Meem.
• Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.
• He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.
• O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0397.answer:
Surah Al-Furqaan (25) — The Criterion · 77 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The One Who has sent me is the Sovereign of the heaven and the earth, who merely says to a thing "Be!" and it is.
• So that they might learn a lesson from what happened to its inhabitants of punishment for denying the Messenger and going against the commands of Allah.
• All of this comes from a despised liquid
• He would not care to pay attention to you if you did not worship Him, for He only created mankind to worship Him Alone and to glorify Him morning and evening.
• We showed them the proof and gave them clear evidence,' as Qatadah said, "They had no excuse.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0551.answer:
Surah Al-Munaafiqoon (63) — The Hypocrites · 11 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• He has decreed them to be hypocrites because they reverted from faith to disbelief and exchanged guidance for misguidance.
• The hypocrites shield themselves from Muslims when they falsely and sinfully swear to be what they are not in reality.
• When the hypocrites come to you, they announce this statement and pretend to believe in it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0649.answer:
Surah Al-Ghaashiya (88) — The Overwhelming · 26 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They did many deeds and became weary in their performance, yet they will be cast into a blazing Fire on the Day of Judgement.
• They will not hear in the Paradise that they will be in, any foolish word.
• Charged with Delivering the Message
• Flowing freely. This is mentioned with the intent of emphasizing affirmation.
• The Threat for Whoever Turns Away from the Truth

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Transliteration: Khatamal laahu 'alaa quloobihim wa 'alaa sam'i-him wa 'alaaa absaarihim ghishaa watunw wa lahum 'azaabun 'azeem

Translation: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.

     to reach the peak in generosity in the month of Ramadan when Gabriel 
     met him. Gabriel used to meet him every night of Ramadan to teach him 
     the Qur'an. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the most generous person, even more 
     generous than the strong uncontrollable wind (in readiness and haste 
     to do charitable deeds)..

Sahih al-Bukhari 97. Chapter: Knowledge. English: Narrated Abu Burda's father: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "Three persons will have a double reward:


     1. A Person from the people of the scriptures who believed in his 
     prophet (Jesus or Moses) and then believed in the Prophet (ﷺ) Muhammad (i 
     .e. has embraced Islam).


     2. A slave who discharges his duties to Allah and his master.


     3. A master of a woman-slave who teaches her good manners and educates
     her in the best possible way (the religion) and manumits her and then 
     marries her.".

q-3833.answer:
Here is what the Quran, Hadith, and duas say:

• Tafsir 5:54 (ibn_kathir_en)
O you who believe! Whoever from among you turns back from his religion (Islam), Allah will bring a people whom He will love and they will love Him; humble towards the believers, stern towards the disbelievers, fighting in the way of Allah, and never fearing the blame of the blamers. Transliteration: Afaman Huwa qaaa'imun 'alaa kulli nafsim bimaa kasabat; wa ja'aloo illlaahi shurakaaa'a qul samoohum; am tunabbi'oona hoo bimaa laa ya'lamu fil ardi; am bizaahirim minal qawl; bal zuyyina lillazeena kafaroo makruhum wa suddoo 'anis sabeel; wa mai yudlilil laaahu famaa lahoo min haad;

Translation: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allah they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allah leaves astray - there will be for him no guide.

Quran 14:26 — Ibrahim (Abraham)

Quran 48:29 — Al-Fath (The Victory)

مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا

Transliteration: Muhammadur Rasoolul laah; wallazeena ma'ahooo ashiddaaa'u 'alal kuffaaari ruhamaaa'u bainahum taraahum rukka'an sujjadany yabtaghoona fadlam minal laahi wa ridwaanan seemaahum fee wujoohihim min asaris sujood; zaalika masaluhum fit tawraah; wa masaluhum fil Injeeli kazar'in akhraja shat 'ahoo fa 'aazarahoo fastaghlaza fastawaa 'alaa sooqihee yu'jibuz zurraa'a liyagheeza bihimul kuffaar; wa'adal laahul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati minhum maghfiratanw wa ajran 'azeemaa

Translation: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
